gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 defined glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Lomustine (other names: CCNU, Gleostine): Given orally (PO)
Approximately 7 days following LITT, lomustine is administered per standard of care on Day 1 for a total of one cycle.

candidate_flag.reason: Lomustine is an established GBM therapy given per standard of care; tested only in the new sequence after LITT (device). Could be read as the tested element or as backbone; either way not a candidate, but adjudicate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Laser Interstitial Thermal Therapy (LITT) and Lomustine (CCNU) for Recurrent Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: evaluating the safety and feasibility of laser interstitial thermal therapy (LITT) followed by lomustine (CCNU) for recurrent glioblastoma in adults

flag.reason: Established GBM therapy; coded as being tested in a new setting (after LITT) rather than as plain backbone. Neither makes it a candidate.

coder_notes: Single-arm safety/feasibility of LITT (device) followed by one cycle of standard lomustine. Record gives no sign that LITT enables drug delivery or activation, so device_dependent is false. No candidate under the manual (established therapy only).
